_about: Every ROM/RAM range that a flashed rev changes or a patch occupies OUTSIDE a definition-XML table. Checked by scripts/rom_allocation.py (gate 6 of docs/pipeline-plan.md). A new patch adds its claims here in its plan, before it is built. Never hand-delete a claim: retire it with "retired": "<date> <reason>".
_proof: scripts/rom_allocation.py --audit rom/*.bin: every byte that any flashed rev changes vs stock, outside a definition table/axis and the checksum table, falls inside a claim below (2026-11-15: 18 of 18 revs).

never_touch.why: Covered by no checksum record in any bin (rom_checksum.py). Contents not analysed; vector table expected here. A corruption here is not caught by the ECU's own check.
Covered by no checksum record. 0x0FFAF8 holds 8 non-0xFF bytes in every bin; not analysed.
The checksum table and its terminator. Only scripts/rom_checksum.py --fix writes the stored sums; ranges are never changed.
Covered by no checksum record. Not analysed.

rom.note: Replaces the stock SSM read-addresses index lookup with direct tagged RAM reads.
Both cut/resume pair loads rewritten to mov.l @(pool),r0 / jmp @r0.
Detour, not a call: adds an offset to fr15 (rpm) and jumps back to 0x03B6B2.

Stock floats +0.5 / -0.5, zero in every flashed rev. Bounds of float_clamp_range (0x0BE56C) at 0x03572E-0x035736; the clamped value is stored to FFFF7904 (three conflicting labels: fuel_corr_param_A / aggregator_fuel_output / afc_aggregator_output). Identity of the zeroed term NOT settled.
'Wastegate Duty Cycle Frequency' is defined, but its scaling '0.01' does not resolve in scripts/defs.py, so it has no byte extent. Stock 0x3FF7 -> 0x2710 in every rev. Width and unit unverified.
uint16 0 -> 438, the candidate edit at transient_knock_window_trace.txt:195. Not in any definition XML.

ram._note: No patch on the car writes RAM. A new patch that needs RAM claims it here with the evidence that nothing else reads or writes it (scripts/mapping/find_writers.py + a reader scan, indexed and GBR forms included). There is no proven-free RAM yet. On-chip RAM is 0xFFFF0000-0xFFFFBFFF (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
